old_cup=headset.cup_grasps;old_hang=L.hang_on_hooks;old_transfer=__import__('dojo.skills.skills',fromlist=['Skills']).Skills.plan_transfer
meta={'banks':[],'staging':[]};context={}
def bridge_frame(o):return L.functional_frames(o,'headband_bridge',active=True)[0]
def upright(o):return float((o.T@bridge_frame(o))[2,2])>.95
def bank(sk,o,arm,tag='headband_bridge'):
 if not upright(o):
  gg=old_cup(sk,o,arm,tag)
  for g in gg:g.clear_w=G.MAX_GAP

 H=o.T@bridge_frame(o);out=[]
 for xx in (0.,-.025,.025,-.045,.045):
  for dz in (0.,-.004,-.008):
   for tilt in (70.,80.,90.):
    for sign in (-1,1):
     app=H[:3,:3]@np.array([sign*np.sin(np.radians(tilt)),0.,-np.cos(np.radians(tilt))])
     for flip in (-1,1):
      T=T_from(H[:3,3]+H[:3,0]*xx+H[:3,2]*dz,G._frame(app,H[:3,1]*flip))
      w=G.mesh_width_at(o,T,depths=(0.,.004,.008))
      if w is None or not .006<=w<=.06:continue

 meta['banks'].append({'asset':o.asset.key,'arm':arm,'n':len(out)});print('BRIDGE_BANK',arm,len(out),flush=True);return out

 sk.coll.held_table='mesh';H=L.hook_frames(sk.world.obj(rack),hook_tag)[0][1];context['H']=H
 o=sk.world.obj('headset');R=(H@inv_T(bridge_frame(o)))[:3,:3]
 print('UPRIGHT_STABLE',L.rests_stably(o,R),flush=True)
 if not upright(o):
  if not L.rests_stably(o,R):return {'ok':False,'stage':'unstable upright geometry'}
  for xy in [(x,y) for y in (-.25,-.28,-.22) for x in (0.,-.05,-.1,.05)]:

   r=sk.plan_transfer('headset',[T],max_full=24,grasps=lambda a:bank(sk,o,a),pick_kw={'squeeze':8},place_kw={'pre_h':.03,'approach_rad':.03,'approach_staged':True})
   if isinstance(r,SkillResult):print('UPRIGHT_REFUSE',xy,r.note[:300],flush=True);continue
   rr=sk.run_transfer(*r,tol_xy=.015,tol_tilt=25.,tol_z=.05);meta['staging'].append(vars(rr));print('UPRIGHT_RESULT',str(rr),flush=True);sk.bank();break
  sk.ex.hold(30,name='upright_rest_proof');sk.refresh();o=sk.world.obj('headset')

L.SKILLS['hang_on_hooks']=hang

set -euo pipefail

cd "$HOME/controlr-laptop"
exec 9>>"$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:-dojo-gpu-light7.lock}"
flock -w 14400 9
source scripts/dojo/disk_guard.sh
disk_guard laptop
who > "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"

printf 'pid=%s stream=LAPTOP start=%s\n' "$$" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:-dojo-gpu-light7.lock}"
exec timeout -k 60 1800 systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=8G -p CPUQuota=600% scripts/simlab/rdpy.sh -u "$@"
